steps.name: Large animal set
steps.do: On **Add Animals by Region**, select multiple regions; keep many animals.

steps.name: Short visit window
steps.do: After finish (or in planner), set arrival/departure to a short window (e.g. 2 hours).

steps.name: Visit window expands to fit
steps.do: Inspect **Arrival time**, **Departure time**, list view, and Day Planner.
steps.expect: Bulk scheduling adjusts arrival/departure to fit the day; animals are scheduled (not left list-only unscheduled).
